name: App rating
route: No live route — system-triggered bottom-sheet overlay after positive in-app moments
annotation: Non-blocking bottom-sheet overlay fired after a positive in-app moment: dimmed backdrop, CIA-avatar greeting, a five-star input that routes 4-5 stars to a native App Store prompt and 1-3 stars to private feedback, with 'Not now' (30-day cooldown) and 'Don't ask again' (permanent suppression) always available — no live route, never gamified, never guilt-tripped.
trustControls: Trigger-reason ChipProvenance ('milestone reached') renders only in debug/support builds — deliberately withheld from the consumer sheet by default, an honest omission rather than a missing chip
Star rating is honest-null by default: zero stars filled until a real tap-release selects 1-5; a drag/hold before release is a low-confidence preview fill only, never counted as a submitted value
Store review handoff only ever claims a native prompt was requested — copy never guarantees the OS will display it (low-confidence framing), and no store-review claim renders before a star is chosen
Feedback submission (1-3 star path) shows a real sent/queued timestamp or an honest offline-queued state — never a silent optimistic success

Cooldown enforced without dark patterns: 'Not now' or backdrop/drag dismiss = 30-day suppression, a completed rating or feedback = 60-day suppression, 'Don't ask again' = permanent suppression — no repeated nagging, no shame copy
HonestNullState: with no qualifying trigger, the sheet never renders at all — no forced or empty prompt
No live route: this is a system-triggered modal only, never given a deep-linkable route or added to the nav pill

modules.build: Full-screen tap scrim rgba(10,10,15,.72) over the dimmed underlying tab screen; status bar stays visible as system chrome, not a module here. Tap-to-dismiss shares the same 30-day cooldown path as "Not now" below — never a silent, unlogged exit.

Sheet top edge, r28 top corners only, glass fill (white 4.5%, border white 8%) over #211008 base, 24px side pad. Centered 36x4px drag handle, paper-100 40% opacity. Drag-down gesture shares the same cooldown path as "Not now" and the backdrop tap.

CIA persona avatar, 56px circle, single soft --glow-cia ring (purple #7F24FF, 20% opacity, static not breathing — identity, not a synthesis insight, keeping this the screen's one permitted glow). ChipProvenance "milestone reached" renders only in debug/support builds; the consumer sheet shows the avatar alone.

H2 24, centered, paper-100: "Enjoying Balencia?" Body 15 below, paper-64%, centered, max-width 300px: "We'd love to hear your *rating*." One Newsreader Medium Italic emphasis word, "rating" — the screen's only italic moment; no second italic appears in later-state copy.

NEW StarRatingInput: five 44px star targets, centered, 12px gaps, orange #FF5E00 fill. Honest-null default: zero filled pre-tap. Selecting star N fills 1-N center-out with one bounce, a haptic tick, and VoiceOver announcing "1 star" through "5 star." Drag-before-release is a low-confidence preview fill only, never counted as submitted.

BtnGhost "Not now," centered, 44px target — tap starts the 30-day cooldown. Below it, smaller BtnGhost link "Don't ask again," muted paper-40% — permanent suppression, no confirm dialog, no guilt copy, no color shame. HomeIndicator bar anchors the sheet's base, 34px width.

notes: Italic word: Visual System names "*rating*" directly, but unlike sibling screens (03c/"begin", 42/"consistency", 66/"track") this spec's own Final Composition ASCII never asterisk-marks a word in context, and no competing literal candidate appears anywhere else in the spec — so "rating" is applied as-given, worked into the subtitle ("We'd love to hear your *rating*") rather than corrected away from it. Path swap (280ms crossfade, per Motion) replaces star-row + footer-actions after a tap-release selects a star, in plain (non-italic) copy so the screen keeps exactly one italic word total: 4-5 stars (positive) — headline "Thank you.", subtitle "Would you rate us on the App Store?", BtnPrimary "Rate on App Store" (orange fill), BtnGhost "Maybe later"; 1-3 stars (feedback) — headline "We're sorry to hear that.", subtitle "Tell us what we can do better.", multiline input placeholder "Your feedback helps us improve.", BtnPrimary "Submit feedback" dimmed 40% + helper reason until minimum text length or a network queue slot is available, BtnGhost "Skip." Error (store handoff failure): feedback text persists, "Maybe later" ghost appears beside a quiet retry — no red glyphs, no blame copy. Success: whichever BtnPrimary is active turns --glow-done green with a check glyph and the sheet dismisses after a brief confirmation beat. Skeleton is not normally shown; if trigger metadata is still loading, only the sheet's empty geometry appears (shimmer, no fabricated event copy) before headline/CTA content pops in. Reduced-motion: disables the sheet slide-up and star bounce; scrim fade and all state crossfades become opacity-only, per canon. Cooldown state (30-day/60-day/permanent) is enforced in logic even though it is never rendered as a visible chip to the consumer by default — only debug/support builds surface the ChipProvenance trail for trigger reason, cooldown, and feedback status, per the spec's Data Honesty and Components sections.
